mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spectra_core.scheduler_loop_runtime WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_loop_runtime SET status = #{status}, last_cycle_at = #{cycleAt}, last_progress_at = COALESCE(#{progressAt}, last_progress_at), total_cycles = total_cycles + 1, total_processed = total_processed + #{processed}, total_failed = total_failed + #{failed}, consecutive_error_count = #{consecutiveErrorCount}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'DEGRADED') AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at >= #{cycleAt}

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_loop_runtime SET status = #{status}, state_reason = #{reason}, drain_deadline_at = #{drainDeadlineAt}, stopped_at = #{stoppedAt}, lease_expires_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('STOPPED', 'CRASHED', 'UNKNOWN') THEN NULL ELSE lease_expires_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'DEGRADED', 'DRAINING')

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_loop_runtime SET status = #{status}, stopped_at = #{now}, lease_expires_at = NULL, state_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'DEGRADED', 'DRAINING') AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at < #{now}
